{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-plugin 根据AI回复给出建议的下一个提示词","id":"gh:1333329648","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-suggest-prompt","slug":"studyzy/dsh-suggest-prompt","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-plugin 根据AI回复给出建议的下一个提示词"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-suggest-prompt"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"为 DeepSeek Harness 开发的「建议提示词」插件：每个 agent 回合完成后，通过一次有界的辅助 LLM 调用，在插件自己的持久化存储中写入**一条建议的下一条提示词**；Web 端把"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"它渲染成输入框内部的浅色幽灵占位文字，按 **Tab**（默认）即可采纳进草稿（与 Claude Code 一致）。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 想快速上手？直接看 **使用说明**（面向终端用户的操作指南）。
>
> **Read this in English** · 中文文档"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"对于开发者 / 维护者：本仓库是**单个 bundle 包**（`@studyzy/dsh-suggest-prompt`）的权威源码，把宿主生成与浏览器渲染合并为一个可一键安装的 bundle："},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| 包 | 作用 |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| `@studyzy/dsh-suggest-prompt` | 宿主插件（`.`, `./invariant`, `./types`）：在 `turn/end`（reason=`completed"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"`）时生成建议，发布 `suggestPrompt` 会话投影。浏览器插件（`./client`）：读取投影，渲染为输入框内部的浅色幽灵占位文字（`inputActions.setDraft`），按配"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"suggestPrompt` 会话投影。浏览器插件（`./client`）：读取投影，渲染为输入框内部的浅色幽灵占位文字（`inputActions.setDraft`），按配置的快捷键填入草稿。 |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 特性"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"一个自动「接话」助手：AI 答完后，它替你预测下一句该说什么——既省去反复输入，又不会打断你的思路。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **默认轻量**：不配置 `provider` / `model` 时继承主请求最近一次记录的路由，无需为建议单独选模型；需要时也可显式指定任意路由（例如本地 OpenAI 兼容网关）。
- **"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"免思考、快速便宜**：建议生成默认携带 `reasoningEffort: off`（DeepSeek 序列化为 `thinking: disabled`），不消耗推理预算；模型不支持该参数时自动去掉"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"并重试一次。
- **界面配置模型路由**：日常只需在 WebUI「插件」页的「建议提示词」卡片里选择建议生成的 provider / model（或跟随会话路由），保存后下一完成回合生效，无需手动改"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"配置文件。
- **只发最后一轮**：默认只把最后一轮的用户输入与 AI 最终回答发给建议模型（`maxRecentTurns` 默认为 `1`），中间的工具调用 / 推理过程一律不发送。
- **有"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"界调用**：字节 / 令牌 / 超时上限、转录长度预算、建议可见字符上限，全部可配置。
- **安全**：转录在发送前脱敏（密钥形状被掩蔽）；输出净化（控制序列、围栏、引号剥离、单行化）并做语义过滤（"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"元文本、评价套话、助手口吻等被当作「无建议」丢弃）。
- **无建议是常态**：模型回复为空或不合格时静默跳过，不报错、不写事件、不打扰。
- **免调用重显**：删回空草稿会重新显示已持久化的建议，"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"不再发新的模型请求。
- **快捷键可配**：采纳快捷键默认 `Tab`，可在「插件」页的「建议提示词」表单里按实际按键录制（如 `Alt+Slash`、`Ctrl+Enter`）。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 前置条件"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Node.js `^22.19` 或 `>=24`、pnpm。
- 一个基于 deepseek-harness 的 dsh 部署（web profile），**dsh ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2**"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"（0.2.0 变更了会话投影、Web 客户端模块表与设置面板契约，本插件按该版本适配）。浏览器端需要 `conversation.input.overlay` 槽位与 `inputActions.se"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"tDraft`（deepseek-harness 的标准 web 输入机均已提供）。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 安全"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **转录脱敏**：AWS `AKIA…`、OpenAI `sk-…`、GitHub `ghp_`/`gho_`/`ghu_`、Slack `xox-…`、JWT、Stripe `rk_…` 等密钥"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"形状在发送前被掩蔽为占位标签。
- **输出净化**：ANSI/OSC/CSI/DCS 序列、C0/C1 控制符、双向覆盖符、孤立代理项被剥离；引号与代码围栏被去除；压缩为单行并截断到 `maxSug"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"gestionChars`。
- **语义过滤**：元文本（"no suggestion"、"stay silent"）、错误回显、评价套话（"thanks"、"looks good"、谢谢、不错）、"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"助手口吻（"Let me…"、"I'll…"、我来、我帮你）、多句 / 过长回复、孤立单词会被当作「无建议」丢弃，而不是显示。"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 已知限制"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- 每个完成回合都会生成（与输入框是否已有内容无关），幽灵文字只在草稿为空时显示。
- 被中止（取代）的生成不会为较早回合留下建议。
- 空回复或被过滤的回复 = 该回合无建议：不写建议记录，投影保持"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" `null`，也不记录警告。
- 投影保留最后一条建议：重新打开旧会话会显示其最终建议，且不发起新的模型调用。
- 建议模型的路由与预算由部署配置决定；无法关闭思考的模型（如部分 pi-ai 路由）"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"会回退为模型默认的推理行为，想获得最快的建议体验，建议选支持关闭思考的路由（如内置 DeepSeek）。"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"An automatic "next line" companion: after the AI answers, it predicts what you'd say next — saving r"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"epeated typing without interrupting your flow."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Prerequisites"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Node.js `^22.19` or `>=24`, pnpm.
- A dsh deployment built from the DeepSeek Harness (web profile)"},{"id":"p21s2","text":", **dsh ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2** (0.2.0 changed the session-projection, web client module-table, and settings-"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"surface contracts; this plugin is adapted to it). The browser side needs the `conversation.input.ove"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"rlay` slot and `inputActions.setDraft` — both standard in the deepseek-harness web input machine."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Transcript redaction**: AWS `AKIA…`, OpenAI `sk-…`, GitHub `ghp_`/`gho_`/`ghu_`, Slack `xox-…`, "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"JWTs, and Stripe `rk_…` secret shapes are masked before the transcript reaches the model.
- **Output"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" sanitization**: ANSI/OSC/CSI/DCS sequences, C0/C1 control characters, bidirectional overrides, and "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"lone surrogates are stripped; quotes and code fences are removed; text is collapsed to one line and "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"truncated to `maxSuggestionChars`.
- **Semantic filtering**: meta-text ("no suggestion", "stay silen"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"t"), error echo, evaluative filler ("thanks", "looks good"), assistant-voice phrasing ("Let me…", "I"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"'ll…"), multi-sentence or over-long replies, and stray single words are dropped as "no suggestion" i"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"ntence or over-long replies, and stray single words are dropped as "no suggestion" instead of shown."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known Limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Generation runs after every completed turn regardless of whether the composer already holds text; "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"the ghost text is only *displayed* while the draft is empty.
- A superseded (aborted) generation lea"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ves no suggestion for the older turn.
- An empty or filtered reply means "no suggestion" for that tu"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"rn: no record is written, the projection stays `null`, and no warning is logged.
- The projection pe"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"rsists the last suggestion, so reopening an old session shows its final suggestion without a new mod"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"el call.
- The suggestion route and budget are deployment configuration; a model that cannot turn th"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"inking off (some pi-ai routes) falls back to its default reasoning behavior — for the fastest sugges"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"tions, pick a route that supports `off` (such as the built-in DeepSeek)."}],"truncated":true}
